<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/exceptions/{caseId}/assign"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Gives the case an owner (an operator id) and moves it to `ASSIGNED`.
Reassigning is allowed while the case is not resolved. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`. Publishes `ExceptionAssigned`.
